batch: Workspace Data Model, Quick Open, Layout Presets, Advanced Features
activeNote: Implementing workspace functionality according to PRD (FR1000-FR1006). Phase 1: Data Model, Phase 2: Quick Open, Phase 3: Layout Presets, Phase 4: Advanced Features.

implementationNotes.workspacePhases: Task 140-143 implement workspace functionality in 4 phases. Each phase depends on the previous one.
implementationNotes.prdCompliance: All workspace features must comply with PRD definitions for FR1000-FR1006.
implementationNotes.openspecReference: Each task corresponds to an OpenSpec change in openspec/changes/workspace-*/
implementationNotes.backendRequired: Tasks 140, 141, 143 require backend API support for CRUD operations.

tasks.title: Rust agent core and orchestrator
tasks.description: Create src-tauri/src/agent and land the real backend orchestrator, provider trait, runtime session service, and Tauri command entry points.

existingCode.note: Frontend runtime shells exist, but src-tauri/src/agent does not exist yet.

steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent and module exports
Define AgentOrchestrator, provider trait, and runtime session service
Register agent commands in lib.rs invoke_handler
Define request and response contracts for frontend runtime integration
Ensure the main execution loop is interruptible, traceable, and persistable

tasks.title: Runtime event streaming bridge
tasks.description: Upgrade the frontend event model into a real frontend-backend runtime event bridge for progress, tool, error, and completion events.

existingCode.note: Current event emission is local to the frontend and not driven by real backend execution.

steps: Define runtime event protocol and event type mapping
Implement backend to frontend event bridge
Connect StreamingHostContext to the real event source
Handle ordering, reconnect, replay, and interruption consistency
Verify chat and debug panels consume real runtime events

tasks.title: Real tool execution pipeline

existingCode.note: registerCoreTools is still a placeholder and there is no backend ToolExecutionPipeline.

steps: Implement backend ToolExecutionPipeline
Bind tool descriptors to real executors
Register core tools and remove placeholder behavior
Integrate permission checks, sensitive action detection, and confirmation flow
Normalize tool results and errors into one runtime contract

tasks.title: Chat host integration and E2E baseline

Connect MessageInput, MessageList, and StagedReviewPanel to the real runtime

tasks.title: Prompt builder and provider request path

tasks.title: Context compression and session summary persistence

steps: Create summary refresh triggers and persistence structures
Generate reusable session summaries and key facts from real history
Implement token budget and compression policy
Feed compressed context back into PromptBuilder

tasks.title: Knowledge retrieval integration

tasks.title: Retry, replan, and checkpoint recovery

Trigger recovery from tool failure, timeout, and interruption

Add loop detection and call budgets
Propagate timeout and failure correctly

Verify no unbounded recursion or privilege escalation

tasks.title: Sub-Agent result return and merge

tasks.title: Sub-Agent monitoring and diagnostics
